fixes.summary: A refusal that was later continued into a native claim was still treated as undelivered, so cancelling it released shared capacity and skipped the original cancellation request.
fixes.approach: neverDispatched() now requires the capacity occupant to belong to the task, the task's current attempt to match, every durable operation of that task to stay short of reserved/effect_started/outcome_unknown and to carry no effectStartedAt/dispatchEnteredAt/preparationEnteredAt, a send operation plus an attempt_queued event for the current attempt as positive evidence, and the absence of native_claimed, rework_requested and task_closed. requestCancellation() adds a journal gate: claim.json, request.json, model-ready.json or worker-context.json denies closure, and state.json must be blocked without a pid.
fixes.behaviourKept: A clean first refusal can still be cancelled and frees capacity; a real native claim still produces the original cancellation request, remoteStopped:false and executionState stop_unconfirmed, and capacity stays until the native stop is provable.

fixes.summary: The export scrubber only matched a credential at the start of a string, so prose, HTTP headers and inline pairs leaked secrets into the delivery export.
fixes.approach: Eleven patterns match anywhere (authorization and proxy-authorization headers including multi-line values, bare bearer/basic, PEM blocks and headers, sk-/gh*/xox*/AKIA prefixes, JWT, URL userinfo, inline secret/token/password keys). Only the credential is replaced and the surrounding sentence survives; clip() scrubs before truncating and never cuts a [redacted] placeholder in half.
fixes.behaviourKept: Exports stay readable, and redactions.fields still names every section that was touched.

fixes.summary: The local CLI composition root injected only {armed, probe}, so an armed and enabled execution stopped at 'No guarded dispatcher is wired' before reading the saved decision.
fixes.approach: The CLI now injects send: input => service.send(input), so automatic dispatch passes through the same admission layer as manual dispatch. Defaults are unchanged: the process still needs --enable-dispatch, the installation still needs enable, and no MCP tool or HTTP route can write.
fixes.behaviourKept: describe() now reports dispatcherWired:true for the real CLI; an unarmed process still returns AUTOMATION_NOT_ARMED and a disabled installation still returns AUTOMATION_NOT_ENABLED.

fixes.summary: The final review index still described 06d52b1 and RC2.
fixes.approach: Section 14 records this review round, the fixes, the new baseline and the RC4 identity; sections 0-13 stay as the historical record of the 11 line.

regressions.name: a refusal continued into a native claim is cancelled for real, never closed as undelivered
regressions.asserts: The queue claim leaves effect and dispatch marks, neverDispatched is false, cancel is not closed, executionState is stop_unconfirmed, capacity stays 1, no task_closed event, cancel.json exists.

regressions.name: missing durable records or an uncertain operation never prove a task was undelivered
regressions.asserts: Deleting the event history denies closure and capacity stays held.

regressions.name: an operation whose outcome is unknown keeps the workflow on the recovery path
regressions.asserts: An outcome_unknown operation and its body state deny closure.

regressions.name: a journal that already recorded a claim blocks the undelivered closure even when the database looks idle
regressions.asserts: The database alone allows closure, but claim.json on disk denies it.

regressions.name: a credential inside review prose is redacted wherever it sits
regressions.asserts: Header, proxy header, URL userinfo and inline token are gone from the export bytes while ordinary prose stays readable.

regressions.name: clipping never splits a credential in half
regressions.asserts: A credential straddling the clip boundary leaves no prefix and keeps a complete placeholder.

regressions.name: inline pairs and header values are scrubbed inside sentences, not only at the start
regressions.asserts: redactSecrets scrubs mid-sentence values and still reports the field.

regressions.name: the CLI composition root wires the guarded dispatcher and still defaults to unarmed
regressions.asserts: status reports dispatcherWired:true, armed:false, httpWrites:false, writeEntry local_cli_only; --enable-dispatch arms the process.

regressions.name: an armed CLI reaches the guarded service instead of stopping at the unwired check
regressions.asserts: Unarmed returns AUTOMATION_NOT_ARMED, armed-but-disabled returns AUTOMATION_NOT_ENABLED, enabled returns DECISION_NOT_FOUND without the not-wired message.
